name: AlphaSense
description: AlphaSense is a market-intelligence and financial-research platform for searching company filings, earnings materials, broker research, expert transcripts, news, internal content, and AI-generated research workflows.
agentUseSummary: AlphaSense is unavailable for generic Relay installation. Although AlphaSense publishes GraphQL, Agent, and Ingestion APIs, its current SaaS authentication starts with an OAuth password grant using an AlphaSense login password and enterprise-issued application credentials, its on-behalf-of flow requires account-team enablement, and its standard terms do not authorize a third-party AI/LLM service to access or expose licensed content without an applicable Services Agreement.

blocked.label: Block unlicensed research and AI access
blocked.description: Document, company, broker, trend, filing, transcript, news, expert, internal-content, generative-search, workflow-agent, watchlist, user, download, export, and related reads are unavailable without an executed agreement authorizing Relay's AI/LLM and cloud-agent use.

blocked.label: Block ingestion and mutations
blocked.description: Document upload, modify, delete, bulk operations, metadata changes, sharing, watchlist mutations, and other GraphQL or REST writes are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block credential and token workarounds
blocked.description: AlphaSense login passwords, service-account passwords, API keys, client IDs, client secrets, refresh tokens, bearer tokens, cookies, browser automation, manually replayed password grants, arbitrary GraphQL, raw HTTP, and private-cloud internal token endpoints are unavailable as substitutes for an approved Relay connection contract.

blocked.label: Block content redistribution
blocked.description: Caching, persistence, retransmission, redistribution, external sharing, derivative substitutes, bulk extraction, or exposing AlphaSense or third-party licensed content to unauthorized users is unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No AlphaSense actions are available without an approved commercial and authentication agreement.

runtimeSupport.description: No AlphaSense wrapper is mounted without an executed AlphaSense agreement and account-team-approved authentication contract covering Relay's AI/LLM cloud-agent use.
No AlphaSense wrapper is mounted without an executed AlphaSense agreement and account-team-approved authentication contract covering Relay's AI/LLM cloud-agent use.

providerSetup.blocker: AlphaSense API access is enabled through the customer's account team and governed by the applicable Services Agreement. The public SaaS flow requires an API key, client ID, client secret, AlphaSense login email, and AlphaSense login password for the initial password grant. The multi-user OBO flow additionally requires an AlphaSense-enabled service account, feature flag, admin authority, operation allowlist, and deployment IP allowlist. AlphaSense's standard terms prohibit credential sharing, third-party access, programmatic access, and use with third-party AI tools, LLMs, or APIs unless expressly permitted by the applicable agreement. Relay has no reviewed grant covering this connector.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep AlphaSense unpublished. Re-evaluate only after AlphaSense and the customer execute terms expressly authorizing Relay's SaaS/cloud agent, AI/LLM, API, licensed-content, attribution, retention, and output boundaries, and AlphaSense supplies an account-team-approved service-account/OBO or other passwordless token-provisioning contract that never requires Relay to collect an Authorized User's login password. Then implement and validate only the provider-allowlisted bounded operations.

evidence.supports: AlphaSense documents its SaaS GraphQL and Ingestion endpoints, directs customers without API access to their account team, and demonstrates authentication with an API key, client ID, client secret, login email, and login password.

AlphaSense documents OAuth2 password-grant authentication, 30-minute access tokens, refresh-token renewal requiring the API key and client credentials, and token revocation; it publishes no authorization-code, PKCE, device, or client-credentials grant on this page.

AlphaSense documents a multi-user on-behalf-of flow built on a password-authenticated service account and requiring account-team enablement, admin authority, a feature flag, an IP allowlist, and an operation allowlist.
AlphaSense documents password-grant authentication and REST operations for uploading, modifying, deleting, and bulk-managing customer documents.

AlphaSense's standard terms make API products and permitted use subject to the applicable Services Agreement, prohibit sharing access methods, restrict third-party access and redistribution, and prohibit use with third-party AI tools, LLMs, or APIs unless expressly permitted.
AlphaSense publishes its current privacy notice for personal data processed through its websites, products, and services.
